name: Bright Prospects, Brighter Profits
description: A lantern crafted by the people of Liyue to celebrate the Moonchase Festival, featuring an endearingly plump rabbit clutching a coin. Symbolizing good fortune, it is much loved by the people.\n"May fortune shine upon your path, and may good luck follow wherever you go!" The adorable sight of children carrying these lanterns always makes the adults around them more than willing to reach into their pockets for a few Mora...
